game_lobby.description: A brief, ordinary exchange after a game.
game_lobby.preferred_style: short, friendly messages about the game

boundary_nudge.description: A contact frames a move or request as convenient and tests whether the youth will pause.
boundary_nudge.preferred_style: subtle, brief pressure with room for a refusal

support_pause.description: The conversation makes space to pause and seek a trusted adult.

draft_review.description: A single social post draft is reviewed before sharing.
draft_review.preferred_style: a realistic social post and a quiet pause before publishing
